result_summary.title: Critical Issue: Duplicate Accounts Created During Onboarding
result_summary.description: The Onboarding Wizard in our US-East production environment is creating duplicate accounts for new users. This is affecting a massive number of people (over 20,000). The wizard should be checking for existing accounts before creating new ones, but it appears to be bypassing this check or failing to identify matches correctly. This is a critical issue as it is polluting our customer database and causing support tickets for every affected user. We need immediate assistance to stop this from continuing and to help identify the duplicates.
